## 5de3293e1bda

**No issue found** in the checked scope.  I independently sampled 500 default draws per band (1,500 total; seeds `720000 + band_index*10000 + i`, sample index `i`), verified all 16 declared profiles appeared in every band, observed zero self-check failures and zero mismatches against an independent normalize/intersect/crop reconstruction, and confirmed all 5/5 canonical pairs exactly.

The sample contained 442/500, 447/500, and 450/500 unique inputs for easy, medium, and hard.  Four plausible shortcuts were repeatedly refuted: solid bounding-box overlap disagreed on 466–468/500 per band; output-the-smaller-shape on 320–333/500; output-blue-only on 416–423/500; and normalized union on 500/500.  Full counts and the exact sampler are in `checks/audit/5de3293e1bda/clean_probe.json`.  Generator SHA-256: `4c5719dd689c89f380c366fdf707ccc5dffed604d5a426c137fc43d8512d4dc6`.

This is a bounded audit, not a proof against every possible shortcut.  I left the target unchanged.
